# Star Laboratories (Pvt) Ltd — Full Product Catalogue

> WHO-GMP certified human & veterinary pharmaceutical manufacturer, Lahore, Pakistan (founded 1960). 482 products. All product information is for general/professional reference; medicines should be used as directed by a registered physician or veterinarian.


## Veterinary / Semi Solid

### Rasomycin I/M Injection
- URL: https://starlabs.com.pk/products/veterinary/semi-solid/rasomycin-im-injection/
- Active ingredient: Oxytetracycline HCl 426 mg
- Class: Tetracycline antibiotic (veterinary)
- Route: Intramuscular
- Uses: Rasomycin is a broad-spectrum tetracycline antibiotic with bacteriostatic activity against a range of gram-positive and gram-negative micro-organisms, as well as rickettsiae, mycoplasma and chlamydia. It is used in veterinary practice for the management of susceptible bacterial infections in animals.


## Human / Injectable

### Adenofort Injection
- URL: https://starlabs.com.pk/products/human/injectable/adenofort-injection/
- Active ingredient: Thiamine HCl 100 mg, Pyridoxine HCl 100 mg, Cyanocobalamin 1000 mcg, Adenosine Triphosphoric Acid 10 mg, Nicotinic Acid 60 mg
- Class: Vitamin B-complex (neurotropic B vitamins with adenosine triphosphate)
- Route: Intramuscular / Intravenous
- Uses: Adenofort is a parenteral neurotropic B-complex preparation indicated as supportive therapy in conditions associated with B-vitamin deficiency, such as neuritis, neuralgia and peripheral neuropathies including diabetic and alcoholic neuropathy. It supplies thiamine, pyridoxine and vitamin B12 together with nicotinic acid and adenosine triphosphate.

- Route: Intramuscular / Intravenous
- Uses: Adenofort 1000 mcg is a parenteral neurotropic B-complex preparation used as supportive therapy in B-vitamin deficiency states associated with neuritis, neuralgia and peripheral neuropathies, including diabetic and alcoholic neuropathy. It provides vitamin B12, thiamine, pyridoxine, nicotinamide and adenosine triphosphate.
